identity.name: MCP Server Builder
identity.description: Scaffolds a FastMCP-based Python MCP server from a tool-list specification: server entry point, tool stubs, transport wiring (stdio + streamable-http), Dockerfile, and a pytest skeleton. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill.

capability.summary: Scaffold a FastMCP server from a tool spec

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: List of tools with names, descriptions and input schemas.

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: Map of file paths to generated contents.

scoring.rationale: Generates code only; output is reviewable before commit.
